name: Citizenship

Concept.name: Citizenship
Concept.description: A person’s legal relationship with a state, which grants rights, protections, and obligations under that state’s laws. In a conceptual model, Citizenship is a legal‑status attribute of a Natural Person that identifies the country or sovereign entity recognising them as a citizen.

ConceptFrom.name: Person
ConceptFrom.description: An individual human who participates in business activities or interactions. The Person concept represents the identity of a human being independent of the roles they may perform, the relationships they may have, or the contexts in which they act.

ConceptTo.name: Formally Recognised Citizenship
ConceptTo.description: Formally Recognised Citizenship captures a person’s legally conferred nationality status as recognised by a sovereign state or authority. It reflects official citizenship(s) in force, with provenance to authoritative sources (e.g., passport, national identity registry, certificate of naturalisation).
